text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day.
I handed Neo Universe a batch of fan letters
that had arrived for her recently.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: It's a fan letter for Universe

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Because it is “mysterious,”
—I am searching for the “conclusion.”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still, the person who sent the letter—
was only "watching" Neo Universe.
...Why?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Somehow, I understood what she was trying to say. She must find it strange that people who aren't directly involved with her are showing such an interest in her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if they didn't compete directly,
even if they weren't there in person,
people's emotions can still be shaken to their core.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "As if blinded by the overwhelming brilliance and heat radiating from her as she runs..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: This is a form of socializing too, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Socializing.
I managed to do... that much.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, in that case... my heart is truly "full."
Sfera... Sfera!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back in her room, Neo Universe
began reading her fan letters.
Savoring the bonds forged with each and every one...
